/-- Helper: for n ≥ 1 there exist distinct natural numbers a_i (indexed by i : Fin n) such
    that a_i < n^2 and (i.val + 1) ∣ a_i. -/
lemma Erdos711.exists_bounded_multiples (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    ∃ a : Fin n → ℕ, Function.Injective a ∧ ∀ i : Fin n, a i < n^2 ∧ (i.val + 1) ∣ a i := by
  have h : n ≤ n^2 := by exact Nat.le_mul_of_pos_of_le (Nat.succ_pos 0) (Nat.le_refl n)
  refine ⟨fun i ↦ (n^2) * ((i : ℕ) + 1), ?_⟩
  constructor
  · intro i j h
    simp at h
    nlinarith
  · intro i
    constructor
    · have h1 : (n^2 : ℕ) * ((i : ℕ) + 1) ≥ n^2 := by
        have h2 : ((i : ℕ) + 1) ≥ 1 := by
          have h3 : (i : ℕ) ≥ 0 := Nat.zero_le _
          nlinarith
        nlinarith
      have h2 : (n^2 : ℕ) * ((i : ℕ) + 1) < n^2 * n := by
        have h3 : n^2 * ((i : ℕ) + 1) = n^2 * ((i : ℕ) + 1) := rfl
        have h4 : (i : ℕ) + 1 ≤ n := by
          have h5 : (i : ℕ) < n := Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Fin.le_val i) (Nat.le_succ n)
          nlinarith
        have h5 : n^2 * ((i : ℕ) + 1) ≤ n^2 * n := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (n^2) h4
        have h6 : n^2 * n = n^2 * n := rfl
        have h7 : n^2 * n < n^2 * n + 1 := Nat.lt_succ_self (n^2 * n)
        nlinarith
      nlinarith
    · exact ⟨(i : ℕ) + 1, Nat.mul_comm (n^2) ((i : ℕ) + 1)⟩
